historical_failure_contexts.selection_note: Actual step40 separates successful and failed historical policies after an identical39-action prefix; step37 deviation also occurred in successful episodes. Neither observation alone proves a cause.

semantics.positive_local_projection: A positive projection predicts increasing the fixed-before-competitor reference-action gap.
semantics.negative_to_positive_recovery: Strict before-gap<0 and after-max-other-gap>0; exact ties are separate. Action-recovery counts use actual argmax and can differ at ties.
semantics.adam_terms: Additive projections use the same actual post-update second-moment denominator and clipping coefficient. Independent ablations recompute their own moments and clipping.
semantics.arm_comparison: Matching absolute updates across arms generally have different prior parameters and moments; these cross-arm comparisons are descriptive, not same-state loss ablations.

limitations: Retrospectively selected updates and known states, not a representative sample or held-out evaluation.
Global gradient opposition does not determine a particular action gap.
One-step local ranking recovery does not establish episode success or durable training improvement.
Scene10002 actual step40 uses a successful-policy reference action, not a new expert demonstration.
All physical outcomes are reused historical evidence; this analysis performs no rollout.
